about: Rafts: paddling, the logs and lashings creaking, water lapping and rushing between the logs, a sail flapping and filling, bumping a rock and running aground.
notes: v3 (vehicle round). Engine layers are 20 s beds cut to loop, played faster or slower by rpm; slot names match core:vehicle's, so a vehicle of this family is heard by them first and by core:vehicle for the rest.

prompts.text: A wooden paddle dips and pulls through calm water: a splashy stroke and drips, six separate strokes with pauses. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
A log raft drifts on a gentle swell: wooden logs and rope lashings creak and groan slowly, water lapping between the logs, steady. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
Calm water laps and gurgles gently between floating wooden logs, steady and slow. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.

hull/fast.want: water rushing between the logs at speed

prompts.text: A wooden log raft moves quickly downriver: water rushing and splashing between the logs, steady. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
A canvas sail luffs and flaps in the wind with ropes rattling and slapping, steady gusty flapping. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
A canvas sail catches the wind and fills with a sudden heavy whump and a creak of the mast, four separate times with pauses. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
A heavy wooden log raft bumps against a rock: a hollow wooden knock and creak, five separate bumps with pauses. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
A wooden log raft runs aground on a sandy shore: the logs scrape and grind on sand and pebbles, three separate times with pauses. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
